entities.name: Zirilan of the Claw
entities.description: Old viashino warlord of the Great Desert with supernatural control over dragons.

entities.name: Jolrael
entities.description: Ally of Zirilan who defected from the Mirage War side.

entities.name: Hivis of the Scale
entities.description: Ally of Zirilan who bent Jamuraa's dragons to his will.

entities.name: Kaervek
entities.description: Leader on whose side Zirilan and Jolrael joined in the Mirage War.

entities.name: Mirage War
entities.description: War Zirilan joined with Jolrael and Kaervek.

events.summary: Zirilan forges a pact with the dragons, brokering peace between their tribes.
events.quote: Zirilan forged a pact with the dragons, brokering peace between their tribes.

events.summary: Zirilan joins Jolrael and Kaervek in the Mirage War, but retreats into the Great Desert after Jolrael defects.
events.quote: He joined the side of Jolrael and Kaervek in the Mirage War , but after Jolrael defected he retreated into the Great Desert.

relations.quote: He was an ally of Jolrael and Hivis of the Scale .
He was an ally of Jolrael and Hivis of the Scale .
